designationHistory.name: Chase Lake Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt established the Chase Lake Reservation by Executive Order 932; it is now Chase Lake National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Chase Lake National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Wikisource transcription of Executive Order 932 (Aug. 28, 1908): Establishing Chase Lake Reservation in North Dakota as Reserve and Breeding Ground for Native Birds
Theodore Roosevelt, A Book-Lover's Holidays in the Open (1916), Appendix B: list of bird reservations created by executive order, with dates

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Chase Lake National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1908 under President Theodore Roosevelt as a reserve and breeding ground for native birds, making it the 15th refuge established in the country.
